description_en: Calls the CreatePhysicalConnection operation to apply for an Express Connect circuit
description_zh: 调用CreatePhysicalConnection接口申请物理专线接入
kebab_example: aliyun vpc create-physical-connection --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --access-point-id ap-cn-beijing-ft-A --line-operator CT --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreatePhysicalConnection

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Express Connect circuit.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
物理专线所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the access point where the Express Connect circuit is located
parameters.help_zh: 物理专线所在的接入点ID。
parameters.name: access_point_id

parameters.help_en: The type of the Express Connect circuit. Default value: VPC
parameters.help_zh: 物理专线的类型。默认值为VPC
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en:
The carrier that provides the physical line for the Express Connect circuit. Valid values:

CT: China Telecom.

CU: China Unicom.

CM: China Mobile.

CO: Other carriers in the Chinese mainland. 

Equinix: Equinix.

Other: Other carriers outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
提供接入物理线路的运营商。取值：

CT：中国电信。

CU：中国联通。

CM：中国移动。

CO：中国其他。 

Equinix：Equinix。

Other：境外其他
parameters.name: line_operator

parameters.help_en:
The bandwidth of the shared Express Connect circuits. Unit: Mbit/s.

Valid values: 50, 100, 200, 300, 400, 500, 1000, 2000, 4000, 5000, 8000, and 10000
parameters.name: bandwidth

parameters.help_en: The geographical location of the on-premises data center
parameters.help_zh: 本地数据中心的地理位置。
parameters.name: peer_location

parameters.help_en:
The port type of the Express Connect circuit. Valid values:

100Base-T: 100M Ethernet port.

1000Base-T: 1 GE electrical port.

1000Base-LX: GE single-mode optical port (10 km).

10GBase-T: 10 GE electrical port.

10GBase-LR: 10 GE single-mode optical port (10 km).

40GBase-LR: 40 GE single-mode optical port.

100GBase-LR: 100 GE single-mode optical port.

Different access points support different port types. Before you call this operation, call ListBusinessAccessPoints to query the SupportPortTypes of the target access point. For optical ports, also verify the OpticalModuleModels.

40GBase-LR and 100GBase-LR ports are created based on the actual backend port availability. Contact your account manager for details
parameters.help_zh:
物理专线接入端口类型。取值：

100Base-T：百兆电口。

1000Base-T：千兆电口。

1000Base-LX：千兆单模光口（10千米）。

10GBase-T：万兆电口。

10GBase-LR：万兆单模光口（10千米）。

40GBase-LR：四万兆单模光口。

100GBase-LR：十万兆单模光口。

不同接入点支持的端口类型不同。调用前请通过ListBusinessAccessPoints查询目标接入点的SupportPortTypes；光口还应核对OpticalModuleModels。

40GBase-LR和100GBase-LR需要根据实际后台端口水位情况进行创建，具体水位情况请联系商务经理
parameters.name: port_type

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the redundant Express Connect circuit. The circuit must be in the Allocated, Confirmed, or Enabled state
parameters.help_zh: 冗余物理专线的实例ID。该专线的状态必须为Allocated、Confirmed或Enabled
parameters.name: redundant_physical_connection_id

parameters.help_en:
The description of the Express Connect circuit. 

The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length and must start with a letter or Chinese character. It cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
物理专线的描述信息。 

长度为2～256个字符，必须以字母或中文开头，但不能以`http://`或`https://`开头。
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en:
The name of the Express Connect circuit.  

The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and must start with a letter or Chinese character. It can contain digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-). It cannot start with `http://` or `https://`
parameters.help_zh:
物理专线的名称。  

长度为2～128个字符，必须以字母或中文开头，可包含数字、下划线（_）和短划线（-），但不能以`http:// `或`https://`开头。
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The circuit code provided by the carrier for the Express Connect circuit
parameters.help_zh: 运营商为物理专线提供的电路编码。
parameters.name: circuit_code

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

Generate a parameter value from your client to ensure uniqueness across different requests. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId may be different for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group to which the Express Connect circuit belongs
parameters.help_zh: 物理专线所在的资源组ID
parameters.name: resource_group_id

fields.help_en:
The tag key of the resource. You can specify up to 20 tag keys. If you specify this parameter, the value cannot be an empty string.

The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签键。最多支持输入20个标签键。如需传入该值，则不能输入空字符串。

最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The tag value of the resource. You can specify up to 20 tag values. If you specify this parameter, the value can be an empty string.

The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签值。最多支持输入20个标签值。如需传入该值，可以输入空字符串。

最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The list of device advanced capabilities
parameters.name: device_advanced_capacity
